incident: Universal ingress bound the run to one opaque preflight digest but did not expose or independently validate the current policy, skill and delivery versions consumed by the run.
root_cause: Version truth was implicit inside preflight content instead of being first-class machine-readable receipt fields.
prevention_rule: Every material run must resolve canonical policy, completion-policy, skill-index, skill-projection digest and delivery-state-machine versions from current repository sources at ingress; these versions become part of the signed receipt digest and postflight rejects stale bindings.
enforcement: Agent Fabric gateway requires version fields
completion postflight compares receipt to current canonical versions
